summary: Bilateral increase in perihilar and mid-zone hazy opacity with loss of vascular clarity compared to prior clear lungs.

findings.rationale: Prior shows well-defined vascular markings with clear lung fields bilaterally; current shows diffuse hazy perihilar-to-mid-zone opacification with blurred vessel margins on both sides, greater on the right. Increased line/catheter overlay and differing exposure were accounted for and do not explain the bilateral haze.
